slides.title: Families flee Moyale fighting into Kenya
slides.body: A border-town dispute turns into a displacement crisis

slides.title: Fighting spreads beyond Moyale
slides.body: On Oct 22, clashes between Oromia and Somali regional forces spread to localities in Gumi Eldallo, Wachile and Arero districts, Addis Standard reported.

slides.title: households the Kenya Red Cross aims to reach first
slides.body: in Moyale, Marsabit County, with tents, household supplies, fortified flour and first aid.

slides.title: Urgent needs
slides.body: A rapid assessment found families need food, safe water, sanitation, health care and protection, especially women, children, older people and people with disabilities.

slides.title: What is still unknown
slides.body: Neither side has released casualty figures. How many people crossed into Kenya has not been disclosed. Transport in Moyale has halted and houses were reportedly burned.

slides.title: people displaced by earlier border clashes
slides.body: after tensions rose in mid-2025 over a Somali Region administrative restructuring plan, according to Addis Standard.

slides.title: Protect civilians on both sides of the border.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
